items.title: Steve Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 25, 2002
items.q: Bruce Barth, our pianist, just returned from Japan a couple of weeks ago.

ctx.x: Is it hard to get to that place?

It’s very hard. It still is. Because all of these guys are first call musicians. So they end up doing a lot of different work, which is what we all do now, out of necessity. You have to be diversified. In order to make a living in this business you’ve got to be ready to jump into a lot of different situations. And it’s hard to get consistent work with any one group now. I mean, which is what we were talking about the industry and the changes, that’s probably the major thing that has changed. It is almost…
I can imagine, just getting all four of you up here for three days, like schedules—
